positive_cases.name: url_cache_transfer
positive_cases.scenario: Certificate utility used to retrieve a synthetic remote file.
positive_cases.rationale: Image and transfer option selections both match.

positive_cases.name: base64_decode
positive_cases.scenario: Certificate utility used to decode a synthetic placeholder file.
positive_cases.rationale: Image and decode option selections both match.

negative_cases.name: certificate_store_listing
negative_cases.scenario: Certificate utility listing the personal certificate store.
negative_cases.rationale: Image matches but no transfer or decoding option is present.

negative_cases.name: other_tool_decode_switch
negative_cases.scenario: Unrelated helper using a similarly named switch.
negative_cases.rationale: Option text matches but the image is not the certificate utility.

negative_cases.name: certificate_template_query
negative_cases.scenario: Certificate utility queried for template information.
negative_cases.rationale: Image matches but the option list does not.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
